title: Better than I expected!

The game can also be played without wifi (although some levels need higher recourses and sometimes do not load) and some levels are truly brain teasers. I find it annoying that you have to watch an ad every time you complete a level and for some reason a lot of levels include bald people, stinky socks, or men disguised as women- it’s not a big deal but an interesting thing I noticed. This is a fun game to play when you have nothing to do- matter of fact, I have finished all levels because of how fun they all were! I hope they release new levels soon, but for now I’ll complete the first game.

author: jadaa 💕
title: LOVEE this game!!
content:
i wanted to start by saying that this game is extremely underrated and doesn’t get the recognition it deserves. i hope this game becomes more popular in the future!

honestly, a few levels of this game gets a bit too challenging to the point i’m not sure what to do. they make it up by giving the player an option to watch an ad in exchange for a hint! i love the fact that this game doesn’t get repetitive and the levels are creative. i’ve also spotted some references throughout my gameplay, which i think is pretty cool. this is definitely one of my favorite mobile games. i’d 100% recommend playing this game. 

though, the ads do get a bit excessive but i understand why they have to do it. the advertisements are no longer than 15 seconds so i don’t find it a big deal. don’t get me wrong though, the game is amazing! but it seems like they have a genuine fart/stink fetish. you’d see it every now and then through each level but it’s not much of a concern to me, i just felt like pointing that out.. one of the biggest complaints i have is that the game has an ad out that portrays sexual activities. other than that, the rest of the advertisements they put out are true to the game. i say this because other games usually try click-baiting you into playing a game that has nothing to do with what the ad shows. 

don’t let me concerns get in the way of you playing. the game itself is SO addictive and entertaining! the worst part is running out of levels to play ☺️

(try the first version of brain puzzle if you haven’t)
